mechanism: Methimazole can cause agranulocytosis and bone marrow suppression, while furosemide may increase this risk through electrolyte depletion and stress on hematopoietic system; both drugs can affect fluid/electrolyte balance in hyperthyroid patients.
action: Monitor complete blood count periodically during concurrent use; maintain adequate hydration and electrolyte levels; counsel patient on signs of infection or unusual bruising.
